items.content_text: - **Polymarket to take legal action against France over countrywide ban, BitRss reports** — Polymarket said it will challenge France's gambling regulator ANJ in court after the agency ordered internet providers to block access to its website nationwide. items.content_text: - **Polymarket Protocol V2 set for November 2 mainnet switchover, Bonus reports** — Polymarket will fully switch its platform to Protocol V2 on November 2, replacing its original 2019 Gnosis CTF foundation. items.title: CFTC moves to separate prediction markets from sportsbooks in Pennsylvania-focused report
items.content_text: - **CFTC moves to separate prediction markets from sportsbooks in Pennsylvania-focused report** — Play Pennsylvania reported the CFTC announced two actions on October 9 aimed at distinguishing prediction markets from conventional gambling, including a proposed rule classifying sports and other event contracts as swaps. The actions do not transfer oversight of Pennsylvania licensed sportsbooks and casinos away from the Pennsylvania Gaming Control Board. ([Play Pennsylvania](https://www.playpennsylvania.com/news/cftc-moves-to-separate-prediction-markets-from-sportsbook-and-casino-bets/))
